sites.name: ordinary-xy-factor-order
sites.find:
float base_x =
            advanced
                * current_template->secondary_samples[sample_index]
                      .delta_dir_to_next.x
                * lateral_scale
            + current_template->secondary_samples[sample_index]
                  .transform.position.x
            + anchor->x;
        float base_y =
            advanced
                * current_template->secondary_samples[sample_index]
                      .delta_dir_to_next.y
                * lateral_scale
            + current_template->secondary_samples[sample_index]
                  .transform.position.y
            + anchor->y;
